article_title: Canada installs large Lake Ontario sign in latest jab at US

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Ontario's public response to Donald Trump's attempt to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America
Canada's plan to build a new bridge across Lake Ontario
A scientific project to measure pollution in the Great Lakes
New rules requiring all Great Lakes to have French names
tasks.correct_answer: Ontario's public response to Donald Trump's attempt to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת כיצד אונטריו הגיבה בנחרצות ובאירוניה לניסיון של טראמפ לשנות את שם האגם.

tasks.prompt: What message appeared on the large sign unveiled by Ontario Premier Doug Ford?
options: Welcome to Lake America
Lake Ontario. Now and Always.
Ontario and New York Together
The Smallest Great Lake
tasks.explanation_hebrew: על השלט שהציג דאג פורד נכתב: Lake Ontario. Now and Always.

tasks.prompt: What followed the collapse of US-Canada trade talks?
options: Both countries immediately removed all tariffs
Canada agreed to use the name Lake America
The US imposed 50% tariffs on $20bn of Canadian goods
Ontario stopped trading with the state of New York
tasks.correct_answer: The US imposed 50% tariffs on $20bn of Canadian goods
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לאחר קריסת השיחות הטילה ארה״ב מכסים של 50% על סחורות קנדיות בשווי 20 מיליארד דולר.

tasks.prompt: Why can Trump's order change official US usage but not force Canada to adopt the new name?
options: The lake lies entirely inside Canada
Only technology companies can name international waters
The order applies only to maps printed before 2025
US authority over domestic naming does not bind another country sharing the lake
tasks.correct_answer: US authority over domestic naming does not bind another country sharing the lake
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לנשיא ארה״ב יש סמכות לגבי השימוש הרשמי בארצו, אך אין לכך תוקף מחייב כלפי קנדה.

tasks.prompt: What does “straddles both countries” mean when describing Lake Ontario?
options: It has disappeared from maps in both countries
It extends across the border area shared by the two countries
It is owned by two private companies
It changes direction twice each year
tasks.correct_answer: It extends across the border area shared by the two countries
tasks.explanation_hebrew: straddles פירושו שהאגם משתרע משני צדי הגבול ונוגע בשתי המדינות.

tasks.prompt: What does “counter-tariffs” mean in the article?
options: Payments made to remove road signs
Taxes that replace all domestic sales taxes
Import charges imposed in response to another country's tariffs
Fines for using an unofficial geographic name
tasks.correct_answer: Import charges imposed in response to another country's tariffs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: counter-tariffs הם מכסי תגובה שמדינה מטילה כנגד מכסים שהטילה עליה מדינה אחרת.

tasks.prompt: Give four facts about Lake Ontario or the official naming process described in the article.
